house.why: Late Republican mosaic floors and painted walls: running spirals, lens-petal circle grids and meander borders in tesserae, the Hellenistic craft Rome brought home.

ideologies.name: Libertas

fit.variant: A sparse line-only running spiral in Egyptian blue on near-black: the Greek philosophers' wave, austere and unbroken.
fit.emblem: The pileus, the freedman's cap of the EID MAR denarius.

ideologies.why: Open single-line spiral for an austere, philosophical creed; the liberty cap as its emblem; cool blue for aristocratic restraint.

ideologies.name: Optimatism

fit.variant: Ordered lens-petal circle grid of a Republican mosaic floor in toga-border purple: dignified, regular, ancestral.
fit.emblem: The laurel wreath of senatorial honour.

ideologies.why: A stately, regular mosaic grid for the Senate's order; laurel for ancestral honour; the purple of the toga praetexta.

ideologies.name: Caesarism

fit.variant: A bold, dense meander in triumphal red edged with gold: martial, angular, regular as a legion on the march.
fit.emblem: The sidus Iulium, the star of Caesar.

ideologies.why: Hard angular meander for martial discipline; Caesar's star as emblem; the red of the general's cloak with gold.

ideologies.name: Popularism

fit.variant: Large filled six-petal flowers of painted plaster in grain ochre: loud, warm and festive.
fit.emblem: Ears of wheat of the grain dole coin types.

ideologies.why: Big bold petal rosettes like crossroads wall painting; wheat ears for the grain dole; ochre of the tenement walls.

factions.name: Liberatores
factions.why: The daggers of the Ides from the EID MAR denarius.

factions.name: The Senate (the consulars and the boni)
factions.why: A column of the Curia and Temple of Concord; the broad purple stripe as accent.

factions.name: The Caesarian party
factions.why: The laurel wreath of Caesar's victories.

factions.name: Caesar's heir and his partisans
factions.why: The star of Caesar the heir claims, in Caesar's gold.

factions.name: The urban plebs and the collegia
factions.why: Ears of wheat from their own insignia.

patrons.name: Ptolemaic Egypt
patrons.why: A neutral Nile lotus in place of the undrawn crown and eagle.

patrons.name: The Kingdom of Galatia
patrons.why: A plain Celtic warrior's shield for the tetrarch-king.
